faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Meydan Free Zone. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.a: Meydan Free Zone is a prestigious free zone in Dubai, known for its association with the iconic Meydan Racecourse and luxury lifestyle. It offers low-cost setup, 100% foreign ownership, and quick licensing within 3-7 working days.

items.q: Where is Meydan Free Zone located?
items.a: Meydan Free Zone is located in Dubai, UAE — near the iconic Meydan Racecourse. It provides excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and major highways and airports.

items.q: What is included in the Meydan setup package?
items.a: Depending on the package, you get the Free Zone license, residency visa, medical & Emirates ID, lease agreement, bank account assistance, premium address, and free VAT consultation.

items.q: How much does a Meydan package cost?
items.a: Our Meydan packages start from AED 5,999 (Economy) and go up to AED 16,999 (Mainland + Residency). Premium packages with visa start at AED 14,499.
Typically 3-7 working days for license issuance, and additional 1-2 weeks for visa processing and bank account opening.
Yes. All packages are starting points and can be customized to match your business, visa needs, and budget.

items.q: Do I get a UAE residency visa?
items.a: Yes, select packages include a UAE investor/residency visa with medical, Emirates ID, and status change. The Free Zone License with Lifetime UAE Residency even offers lifetime residency.
Yes. All packages include free assistance with corporate bank account opening at top UAE banks.

items.q: What activities can I do in Meydan Free Zone?
items.a: Meydan supports sports & equestrian, hospitality & tourism, automotive & luxury, luxury & lifestyle, F&B & restaurant, events & entertainment, and other premium industries — with up to 5 activities in most economy packages.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for Meydan setup?
items.a: We offer transparent pricing, premium industry expertise, dedicated consultants, and end-to-end support — from license to visa to bank account. All with 10,000+ successful setups.
